notice: HUMAN-CURATED EVALUATION LABELS, NOT OBJECTIVE TRUTH. Labels express a prior expectation of relative cultural proximity between a brand and candidate territories. They make no claim that any brand has extended, or would succeed, in any territory. Pairwise assertions (A should rank above B) are the primary test; absolute labels are secondary.

labelProvenance.curator: Implementing agent (Claude), Sprint 2, pending review by the project owner
labelProvenance.method: Written from general brand knowledge before the Sprint 2 live capture. For five brands no Qloo evidence about the brand had been seen when the labels were written (labelsWrittenBlind = true). Jacquemus labels were written after the Sprint 0B live results had been seen, so Jacquemus is assigned to the calibration subset and never to held-out evaluation.

ownerReview.note: Labels were drafted by the implementing agent in Sprint 2 and have NOT been reviewed by the project owner. Agents and the runtime never read this file; evaluators report every label-dependent result as provisional until owner_reviewed is true. Labels are never changed automatically.

labelScale.expected_strong: expected near the top of this candidate set for this brand
labelScale.expected_mid: expected in the middle of this candidate set
labelScale.expected_weak: expected near the bottom of this candidate set (includes deliberate weak controls)

split.rule: Split by brand, fixed before any Sprint 2 capture. A brand contributes cases to exactly one subset.
